units.speaker: Anna
units.text: So that's Friday. A train over the street, a pub with the wrong name, a road with a basement, and a bridge with two names.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Did I make the road interesting?

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: A road with a basement. That's a good one.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Tomorrow, Saturday, and the last day.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: More architecture, and a very famous sandwich.
